newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-RUSSIAN FIRM BUYS INTO KALEV -REPORT.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-RUSSIAN FIRM BUYS INTO KALEV -REPORT.

text.p: Kalev, Estonia's largest confectioner, will sell 27 per cent of its shares to the Moscow-based Gallian Guarantee to improve Kalev's market position, newspaper Aripaev said on Thursday.
The deal will give Kalev a 50 percent stake in a packaging plant in Moscow worth 40 million kroons and the shares sold to Gallian will be worth over 120 million kroons, the paper said.

Kalev hopes to avoid the double tariffs applied on Estonian goods exported to Russia and secure market share for years to come, Kalev's managing director Mart Vooglaid was quoted by the newspaper as saying.
If the packaging plant begins operations in 1997, Kalev expects its turnover to be 300 million kroons and profit 30 million kroons, the newspaper added.
